title: SKIPIKET
description: SKIPIKET is a web-based classroom duty management system for Sekolah Kristen Immanuel that helps students and teachers manage daily, weekly, and monthly schedules. It features automated scheduling, role-based access control, notifications, and an intuitive dashboard.

title: MieRendangPerfect
description: MieRendangPerfect is a discord bot that shows upcoming CTF events from CTFtime.org. It allows users to easily stay updated on upcoming CTF events and participate in them.

title: CekFail
description: CekFail is a web-based forensic file analysis tool designed for CTF challenges and cybersecurity learning. It allows users to inspect files, generate hashes, extract strings, detect suspicious indicators, and explore hexadecimal data through a clean and intuitive interface.

title: SIEMP
description: SIEMP is a lightweight web-based SIEM application that simulates real-world security monitoring. It analyzes Linux authentication logs, detects suspicious activity using rule-based methods, and visualizes events through an interactive dashboard with alerts and activity tracking.
